Delete your account

You can delete your account in the app or in your account online. Your account, spaces and walkthroughs are deleted within 30 days.

  1. In the app, open Account and go to Delete your account. Online, it is under Finishing, exporting or leaving in your Veylet account.
  2. Read what happens: your account, spaces and walkthroughs will be deleted within 30 days, shared links stop working when removal begins, and it cannot be undone.
  3. Tap Delete my account and confirm.
  4. It then says "Deletion requested" with the date. Until removal begins, you can still press Cancel deletion.

Captures saved on your iPhone are not touched. Delete the app to remove them. An App Store subscription is not cancelled by deleting your account; cancel it in Settings.

If it doesn’t work

Can’t sign in to delete? Email Veylet support from the address on your account and ask for deletion.

The privacy notice says what is kept after deletion and for how long.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to yoda@yodalai.xyz and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
